H6495.def-en: opening (of a dungeon), i.e. jail-delivery (figuratively, salvation for sin)

H6496.kjv: which had the charge, governor, office, overseer, (that) was set.

H6497.deriv: from an unused root meaning to burst; only used as an architectural term of an ornament similar to פַּקֻּעָה (paqquʻâh, H6498),
outline: 1) knob-shaped or ball-shaped or gourd-shaped carved wood or metal ornament

H6498.deriv: from the same as פֶּקַע (peqaʻ, H6497);
H6498.def-en: the wild cucumber (from splitting open to shed its seeds)

H6499.def-en: a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof)
